_about: RideBuddy fare rates: Rate Table & Fare Estimation Logic v1.10 (locked, founder sign-off 11 Oct 2026), section 3.4. The single source for every rate: the backend (backend/server.py) reads this file at startup, and the website build (website/build.mjs) compiles it into /estimate/ and /beta/. Money is in rupees, at most two decimals. Change a value here, then restart the backend and redeploy the website. Never hardcode a rate anywhere else.
_service_area: PRD 6.2-6.4: where the website prices trips. Pickups within pickup_radius_km of Chandigarh centre, destinations within destination_radius_km (straight line), and a one-way road distance of at least min_trip_km (D4). The website applies them; the backend doesn't use them.
_app_only: hourly_rate prices the app's Hourly trips (backend only); it, the commission, promo and GST rates are left out of the website's pages (website/build.mjs).
